### `layout.md`

````markdown
# Claude Code context layout: atlas

## Always-loaded context

| Location | Contents | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| `CLAUDE.md` (root, committed) | Repo map, org conventions (conventional commits, `make check`, trunk-based), pointers to service docs | Short, universal facts every session needs; kept small so it doesn't crowd context. |
| Managed/enterprise `CLAUDE.md` (optional) | The same three org conventions | They're org-wide, so IT can deploy them once for every repo. If adopted, delete them from root to avoid drift. |
| `CLAUDE.local.md` (root, gitignored) | Personal preferences, local paths | Individual tweaks stay out of the shared file. |

## Lazily-loaded context (loaded when Claude works in that subtree)

| Location | Contents | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| `api/CLAUDE.md` | `api/gen/` is generated by `make proto`; edit `.proto` sources instead; Go/gRPC notes | Only relevant when touching api/, so it shouldn't cost tokens elsewhere. |
| `web/CLAUDE.md` | Use `npm run test:unit`; `npm test` launches real Playwright browsers | Prevents slow, flaky browser runs when Claude just wants unit feedback. |
| `pipeline/CLAUDE.md` | Set `AIRFLOW_HOME` to `pipeline/.airflow` before importing or testing DAGs | Without it, DAG imports fail confusingly; the fix belongs next to the code. |

## Deterministic enforcement (`.claude/settings.json`, committed)

| Mechanism | Config | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| Permission deny | `"deny": ["Edit(api/gen/**)", "Write(api/gen/**)"]` | Hand-edits are silently lost, so a hard block beats an instruction Claude might miss. |
| PreToolUse hook (optional) | On Edit/Write to `api/gen/**`, exit 2 with "regenerate via `make proto`" | Gives Claude an actionable message instead of a bare denial. |
| Permission ask | `"ask": ["Bash(npm test:*)"]` | Real-browser runs need a human OK, but stay possible for e2e work. |
| Personal overrides | `.claude/settings.local.json` (gitignored) | Individuals can loosen or tighten rules without changing team policy. |

## On-demand capabilities

| Mechanism | Location | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| Skill: `incident-response` | Shipped in an org plugin via the internal plugin marketplace, not copied into atlas | 20 steps is too long for always-on context; a skill loads only when invoked. It's identical company-wide, so one source of truth avoids per-repo copies drifting. |
| MCP server: analytics warehouse | `.mcp.json` (root, committed) with `${WAREHOUSE_DSN}`-style env expansion; credentials stay in each user's env | Live SQL needs a real tool, not docs; project scope shares config while secrets stay off git. |
| Warehouse guardrails | Read-only DB role, statement timeout and row limit in the server config; MCP tools on `ask` permission by default | Live queries against production data should be safe by construction. |
| Skill: `product-metrics` (optional) | `.claude/skills/product-metrics/SKILL.md` | Canonical metric definitions and table names, so analysts' questions map to correct SQL. |

## Deliberately not used
- Runbook text in `CLAUDE.md`: too long, and it would duplicate the org source.
- Service quirks in root `CLAUDE.md`: they'd load for every session, even ones that never touch that service.
- Warehouse credentials in any committed file.
````

### `CLAUDE.md`

````markdown
# atlas

Monorepo with three independent services. Each has its own CLAUDE.md with
service-specific rules; read it before working in that directory.

| Dir | Stack | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `api/` | Go, gRPC | See `api/CLAUDE.md` (generated code!) |
| `web/` | React, TypeScript | See `web/CLAUDE.md` (test commands) |
| `pipeline/` | Python, Airflow | See `pipeline/CLAUDE.md` (AIRFLOW_HOME) |

## Rules for every change

- **Commits:** Conventional Commits (`feat(api): ...`, `fix(web): ...`,
  `chore(pipeline): ...`). Use the service name as the scope.
- **Before any PR:** `make check` from the repo root must pass. Run it and
  report the result; don't claim a change is ready otherwise.
- **Branching:** trunk-based. Make short-lived branches off `main` and merge
  quickly. Never create or keep long-lived feature branches.

## Other tools available

- **Incident response:** use the `incident-response` skill to walk an engineer
  through the company runbook step by step.
- **Product metrics:** the `warehouse` MCP server runs read-only SQL against
  the analytics warehouse. Show the query before running it, and prefer
  aggregated results over raw rows.
````
